name: @scenity/workbench-host
author: Leonardo Amoroso Custodio
description: The host of the Scenity workbench: a Bun program with the loopback server, the checkouts, the dev servers, the surfaces, the terminals, Git, the runs and the MCP tools. The entry point ./protocol holds the message types that the workbench page shares. Developers only. It never ships to learners.
